h1: Run Your Business Across Eswatini Nonstop
sub: Deploy persistent AI agents on dedicated cloud computers to manage research, cross-border commerce, coding, and client inquiries even when you are offline.
audience: Agribusiness operators, Matsapha exporters, Ezulwini tourism managers, logistics coordinators, and independent consultants across Eswatini.
manifesto: In a connected Kingdom trading across borders, Ceyo runs tireless cloud agents that research, code, and automate your operations uninterrupted, keeping you ahead across Mbabane, Manzini, and beyond.

uses.d: Autonomous web browser agents monitor global commodity benchmarks, export tariffs, and regional supply chain notices to generate daily market briefs.
Bots coordinate cross-border shipment records in Google Sheets and automate customs documentation checks for transport to South Africa and Mozambique.
Telegram bots respond instantly to traveler inquiries, update reservation calendars, and answer guest questions in English and siSwati around the clock.
Coding agents write, test, and deploy client websites and web applications directly inside isolated cloud computers without draining local office hardware.
Agents autonomously search wholesale distributors across Southern Africa, compare landed pricing, and compile structured inventory purchasing sheets.
Scheduled routines aggregate regional trade policy updates, legal filings, and financial records into comprehensive research summaries every week.

steps.d: Select Plus, Pro, or Ultra and start your 3-day free trial with up to 1,000,000 tokens daily.
Connect your essential apps, set scheduled tasks, and assign specialized roles to your agents.
Interact with your bots via Telegram, voice calls, or your browser while they work 24/7 in the cloud.

chapters.d: Your cloud bot scans regional weather forecasts and Southern African export indices while you commute into Mbabane. A curated digest arrives in your private Telegram channel before your first meeting.
A specialized coding agent executes automated reconciliation scripts across warehouse inventories and shared spreadsheets. Any manifest discrepancies are flagged and summarized for immediate review.

Customer-facing agents manage incoming queries from regional partners, updating your CRM and booking appointments. When a complex inquiry arrives, the agent drafts a contextual reply for your approval.
While your laptop is closed and your phone is off, your bots run automated website stress tests and research market trends on their dedicated virtual machines.

faq.q: How much does Ceyo cost and is there a free trial?
faq.a: Ceyo offers three plans: Plus ($20/month), Pro ($60/month), and Ultra ($120/month). Every subscription starts with a 3-day free trial offering up to 1,000,000 tokens per day, and your linked card is only charged once the trial concludes unless cancelled.

faq.q: Do my bots keep working when my phone or laptop is offline?
faq.a: Yes. Each bot runs on its own isolated cloud computer that operates 24/7 regardless of your device status or local power interruptions, ensuring zero downtime for your critical tasks.

faq.q: Can I manage my AI agents through Telegram?
faq.a: Yes. You can chat with individual agents or create collaborative group chats on Telegram where multiple specialized bots coordinate, share documents, and complete projects as a team.

faq.q: What languages do Ceyo agents support?
faq.a: Ceyo agents process and generate text naturally in English, siSwati, Portuguese, and dozens of other global languages, making communication across regional and international borders effortless.

faq.q: How is my organizational data secured?
faq.a: Every bot operates within a secure, sandboxed cloud environment with encrypted document storage, ensuring your proprietary business data, credentials, and research files remain private.
